description: Source code for a function generating physically random numbers (truerand), including platform-specific timing and signal handling, with comments explaining its purpose and usage.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Sets a timer interval for generating timing-based randomness.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Signal handler that updates the 'done' flag or performs a long jump based on platform.

methods.name: roulette
methods.description: Collects timing entropy by counting in a loop until a timer signal occurs, then processes the count to produce random bits.

methods.name: raw_truerand
methods.description: Generates a 32-bit random number by calling 'roulette' multiple times.
